research_result.description: Salesforce is a CRM and sales platform providing extensive REST APIs and hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to enable AI agent integrations.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can sign up for a free ongoing Salesforce Developer Edition environment. Credentials are generated by creating an external client app or connected app in Salesforce Setup to manage OAuth 2.0 authentication and tokens.

evidence.claim: Salesforce supports OAuth 2.0 protocol for external client apps and connected apps to authorize access to REST API resources.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: For an external client app or connected app to request access, it must be integrated with your org’s REST API using the OAuth 2.0 protocol.

evidence.claim: Salesforce REST APIs support Bearer token authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: URI /services/data/vXX.X/ Formats JSON, XML HTTP Method GET Authentication Authorization: Bearer token Parameters none

evidence.claim: Developers can sign up for a free Developer Edition environment with ongoing access.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Build on Salesforce for free and get hands-on with Agentforce and Data 360.

evidence.claim: Salesforce provides programmatic data access through a broad REST API surface.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: REST API provides you with programmatic access to your data in Salesforce.

evidence.claim: Salesforce offers hosted MCP servers for AI agents to interact with platform data and automation.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Give AI agents a secure, governed way to interact with Salesforce data and automation using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
